meta.name: HTTP Basic Authentication
meta.description: Prompts for a username and password and attaches them as an HTTP Basic credential.
meta.longDescription: Credential source for the `basic` secret type. Registers an auth broker so any feature can require login for a named context, then stores the username/password in memory only and lets HttpClient attach `Authorization: Basic`. Prefer server-side proxy credentials when the login is per-deployment rather than per-user.

error.insecureOrigin: Refusing to send Basic credentials over an unencrypted connection. Use HTTPS.
